title: Toddler Girl Lynn, Porch Steps Pinafore Dress - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century domestic snapshot capturing a toddler girl named Lynn sitting on wooden front porch steps at 'just two yrs.' old, as handwritten on the bottom front border. She wears a puffed-sleeve light-colored play dress with pinafore straps, white socks, and white high-top leather infant walking shoes, with a tiny ribbon in her fine blonde hair. Harsh afternoon sunlight casts a bold silhouette of her profile against the porch riser behind her. In the background, dark shingled siding and a wooden folding chair suggest an American suburban or vernacular residential setting.
